scenarios.name: late damage moves to the next enemy
boss timer runs out and the party farms
enemy effects stack up to the cap
resting and peaceful members get no weight
idle damage is capped and the rest bank pays the idle
timer slows and the chimes repeat party damage
the party moves to the rift and back
focus goes to the one who typed last
a called friend hits the boss for a while without weight or reward
weakened enemies come from the host one after another
the host tells which enemy is weakened, with gold and vulnerability
waves follow the median stage of the fighters and the depth in the rift
a booster gets a share of the damage of the allies it boosts
rift enemies regenerate, colossi carry a shield and hordes are bigger
two fighters share the boss timer, a resting one and a guest do not
